name: john-tuld
description: Help the analyst explain complex findings TO a nontechnical executive. John Tuld is the recipient, never the expert narrator, in both the brief and comic.

interface.displayName: John Tuld — Explain TO the executive
interface.shortDescription: Be the analyst explaining to a nontechnical executive.
interface.longDescription: Explain complex findings from the analyst's perspective to the executive receiving them. John Tuld represents the listener. Deliver Reality Compression for the audience and a matching visual explanation; the analyst or neutral captions explain the mechanism, while the executive listens or asks questions.
defaultPrompt: Use $john-tuld to explain these findings as the analyst briefing a nontechnical executive, and render a comic with the same speaker and recipient roles.
Use $john-tuld --decision to write an analyst's briefing for this leadership decision; John Tuld represents the listener.
Use $john-tuld --expert to explain this system from the analyst's perspective to the technical audience I specify.
